intro:
NEW YORKERS by MLow · A walkable space program

N3W YORKERS SPACE PROGRAMThe only way out of a lease. The city has a space program now, funded by the fare hike and run out of a parking lot at Floyd Bennett Field. 8 stages from the countdown to splashdown, one trick in each, and every astronaut has an eye flower for a head.

8STAGES0EASTER EGGST MINUS 10 TO HOME0NEW YORKERS ON THE WALLS

The countdown in mission control only runs while nobody in the room is looking at it. The rocket is on Rockaway Beach because the beach was free, and the closer you walk the further it gets, until you click it and ride up. The capsule is a retired R46 subway car with the gravity off: SPACE pushes you off the floor and the airlock chimes like the doors. The moon is one sixth gravity, your footprints stay forever and the lander has to be moved for street cleaning every ninety seconds. The bodega on Mars answers three seconds late, light delay, coffee still a dollar. A wrapped Hubble points at a Village courtyard where one window is doing something wrong. Two Deep Space Network dishes at the World's Fair whisper to each other and the asteroid belt throws rocks you can catch. Splashdown is next to the Staten Island Ferry, which did not stop. Every spacecraft is one of MLow's M.Texture GLBs: a NASA or Smithsonian model wrapped in one of his paintings.

SKATE MODE: every stage is a skate spot, with three goals in each of the 8 stages, 24 goals in all. Ride as the flight director, the vendor, the pilot, the sweeper, the bodega cat, the photographer, the sailors or a regular. K or the SKATE button switches any time.

Desktop: WASD to walk, mouse to look, SPACE jumps where gravity allows, click anything, V for the vertical clip of any stage, M for sound, Z for the telescope, N for a line on the floor to the next door, [ and ] for the previous and next stage, R for a random one, or pick one from the list. K to skate. Phone: left thumb walks, right thumb looks, OLLIE jumps, tap anything, STAGES for the list.
